description: Find new-high, VCP, and breakout stocks with strong fundamentals and liquidity. Variant focus: position-sizing context; timeframe: weekly review; response style: QA checklist.
input_patterns: stocks creating new highs or VCP or breakouts with good fundamentals
VCP breakout stocks for TradingView
quality breakouts with strong fundamentals
position-sizing context for weekly review: stocks creating new highs or VCP or breakouts with good fundamentals
quality breakouts with strong fundamentals as QA checklist

review.rationale: Static audit and test findings drive deterministic review.

sql_templates.sql:
SELECT e.symbol, e.trade_date, e.high, e.close, s.enhanced_fund_score, v.vcp_breakout_pct
FROM market.equity_eod e
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots s ON e.symbol = s.symbol
JOIN scores.stage2_vcp_picks v ON e.symbol = v.symbol
WHERE e.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.equity_eod)
AND e.high = e.week52_high
AND v.vcp_score > 80
AND s.enhanced_fund_score > 75

synthesis_guidance: Focus on combining high VCP scores with recent breakout to a 52-week high. Weigh strong fundamentals heavily in candidate selection.
title: VCP Breakouts With Fundamentals Variant 0798
validation_rules: Ensure the stocks use the latest trade date.
Verify the enhanced fundamental score threshold is above 75.
Confirm VCP breakout percentage is significant.
